title: Comments module examples
author: Dongyu Zhao
version: 0.2
date: '2026-09-07'
license: '[CC-BY-SA 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)'
...

The examples of the [comments module](../../../../docs/specs/dialect/comments.md)
in the module's order, byte for byte: the HTML-comment rule of the inherited
grammar that `M0` landed, and the `%%` syntax that `O3` landed. The `%%`
examples carry the `comment` fence tag, which classifies them for the oracle
corpora: cmark judges the untagged HTML-comment examples and has no opinion on
`%%`. The one line that differs from the module is the heading anchor of the
block-boundary example, which the module states in the target grammar and
which `P3` generates; until then the fixture prints `anchor=null` there and
nothing else differs.

## HTML comments

An inline HTML comment token is a `Comment` whose literal is the bytes between
`<!--` and `-->`:

```````````````````````````````` example
a <!-- b --> c
.
Document scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:3..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b " children=0
    └── Text scope=1:13..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The tokens `<!-->` and `<!--->` are comments with an empty literal:

```````````````````````````````` example
a <!--> b <!---> c
.
Document scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:8..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:11..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:17..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An HTML block that opens with `<!--` and whose end line holds only whitespace
after the first `-->` is a block `Comment` whose literal is the bytes between
`<!--` and that `-->`, line endings included, and whose scope runs from its
opener line through its closer line:

```````````````````````````````` example
<!-- c -->

<!--
multi
-->
.
Document scope=1:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Comment scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" c " children=0
└── Comment scope=3:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\nmulti\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Every other HTML block, including one whose end line carries non-whitespace
after `-->`, stays `HTMLBlock` as written:

```````````````````````````````` example
<!-- a --> b
.
Document scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── HTMLBlock scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<!-- a --> b\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## `%%` comments

The opener is `%%` at the cursor, and the body ends at the first later `%%`:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
a %%hidden%% b
.
Document scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:3..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="hidden" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:13..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

`%%%%` is an empty comment; `%%%a%%%` is `Comment("%a")` followed by text
`%`; `\%%` is text. Backslashes inside the body are ordinary bytes.

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%%% %%%a%%%

\%%a%%
.
Document scope=1:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Comment scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Comment scope=1:6..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%a" children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:12..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%a%%" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An escape takes one sign out of a run, and a backslash inside the body is the
body's byte:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
\%%%a%% %%b\%%
.
Document scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%" children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Comment scope=1:9..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b\\" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An inline body may span the lines of one inline container:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
a %%x
y%% b
.
Document scope=1:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x\ny" children=0
    └── Text scope=2:4..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

### Block form

A line whose content is `%%` at indentation zero to three, followed only by
spaces or tabs, opens a candidate that commits when a later line whose content
is the same fence under the same prefixes closes it; the literal is the
intervening lines after prefix removal, each with its line ending:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%
hidden
block
%%
.
Document scope=1:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Comment scope=1:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="hidden\nblock\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The rule applies inside any container:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
> %%
> x
> %%
.
Document scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Comment scope=1:3..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Without a closer line, the opener line is paragraph text and the inline rule
applies to it; an unmatched inline opener is text and hides nothing:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%
text
.
Document scope=1:1..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=2:1..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A block candidate may interrupt a paragraph:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
para
%%
c
%%
.
Document scope=1:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="para" children=0
└── Comment scope=2:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An inline body cannot cross a block boundary. The opener line finds no closer
line, so it is paragraph text; the heading is a heading; and the `%%` on the
last line is unmatched text. The module prints the heading's generated anchor,
which `P3` lands; this fixture prints `anchor=null` there until it does:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%
# h
end %% x
.
Document scope=1:1..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
├── Heading scope=2:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="h" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="end %% x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A comment suppresses all recognition, inherited and extension, until its
closer. Code spans, HTML tokens, and formulas are earlier class-A steps, so a
`%%` inside them is their byte:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%% *a* [[b]] `c` %% `%%`
.
Document scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Comment scope=1:1..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" *a* [[b]] `c` " children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:20..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Code scope=1:21..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Table boundary scanning does not recognize comments: a `|` inside `%%...%%`
on a table row splits the cell and the unmatched `%%` bytes are text:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
| a | b |
| - | - |
| c %% | d %% |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:6..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=3:3..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c %%" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:9..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=3:10..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d %%" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Adjacent, escaped, unmatched, and percent runs

Adjacent comments close and open at consecutive signs; a space between them
is text:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%a%%%%b%% %%c%%
.
Document scope=1:1..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
    ├── Comment scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:6..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Comment scope=1:12..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An escaped backslash leaves the signs after it free to open:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
\\%%a%%
.
Document scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\\" children=0
    └── Comment scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An opener with no closer is text, and a single sign is never a delimiter. An
opener sees only its own inline container:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%% a

a %%

%%%

a % b %% c

%% d
.
Document scope=1:1..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%% a" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a %%" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=5:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%%" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=7:1..7:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a % b %% c" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=9:1..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%% d" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Runs of four or more signs: the first two open, the next two close, and a
leftover is text:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%%%%

%%%%%%

%%%%%%%%

%%% %%%

%%%%a%%
.
Document scope=1:1..9:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Comment scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Comment scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
│   └── Text scope=3:5..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Comment scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
│   └── Comment scope=5:5..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Comment scope=7:1..7:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="% " children=0
│   └── Text scope=7:7..7:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Comment scope=9:1..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
    └── Text scope=9:5..9:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a%%" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Markdown-looking and extension-looking bodies

Every byte between the delimiters is the comment's, as written: escapes,
character references, code, links, images, HTML, and every merged extension's
syntax:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%*a* **b** `c` [d](e) ![f](g) <h> &amp; \* # i%%

%%~~s~~ https://x.y/z www.x.y a@b.cd $f$ $$g$$ \\(h\\) [[w]] ![[e]] ==m== :d[l]{.c} [^n] ^[i] ++x++%%
.
Document scope=1:1..3:101 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:49 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Comment scope=1:1..1:49 anchor=null attributes={} literal="*a* **b** `c` [d](e) ![f](g) <h> &amp; \\* # i" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:101 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Comment scope=3:1..3:101 anchor=null attributes={} literal="~~s~~ https://x.y/z www.x.y a@b.cd $f$ $$g$$ \\\\(h\\\\) [[w]] ![[e]] ==m== :d[l]{.c} [^n] ^[i] ++x++" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A block body interprets no block syntax:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%
# h
> q
- l
```
c
```
| t |
| - |
$$
m
$$
:::d
x
:::
<div>
h
</div>
<!-- c -->
a %% b
%%%
%% d
%%
.
Document scope=1:1..23:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Comment scope=1:1..23:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="# h\n> q\n- l\n```\nc\n```\n| t |\n| - |\n$$\nm\n$$\n:::d\nx\n:::\n<div>\nh\n</div>\n<!-- c -->\na %% b\n%%%\n%% d\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Comments inside opaque constructs

A `%%` inside a code span, a formula, an HTML token or comment, an
angle-bracket autolink, or a bare URL is that construct's byte:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
`%%a%%` $%%b%%$ <i title="%%c%%"> <!-- %%d%% --> <https://x/%%e%%> https://x/%%f%%
.
Document scope=1:1..1:82 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:82 anchor=null attributes={} children=11
    ├── Code scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%a%%" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Formula scope=1:9..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} mode=embedded literal="%%b%%" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:16..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── HTML scope=1:17..1:33 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<i title=\"%%c%%\">" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:34..1:34 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:35..1:48 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" %%d%% " children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:49..1:49 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:50..1:66 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("https://x/%%e%%") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:51..1:65 anchor=null attributes={} literal="https://x/%%e%%" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:67..1:67 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Link scope=1:68..1:82 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("https://x/%%f%%") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:68..1:82 anchor=null attributes={} literal="https://x/%%f%%" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A completed cross link is opaque, and a comment that opened first owns the
brackets inside it:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
[[a %%b]]%%

[[c|%%d%%]]

%%[[e]]%% %%[[f%%]]
.
Document scope=1:1..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── CrossLink scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="a %%b",anchor=null) label=null children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:10..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── CrossLink scope=3:1..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="c",anchor=null) label="%%d%%" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
    ├── Comment scope=5:1..5:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[[e]]" children=0
    ├── Text scope=5:10..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=5:11..5:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[[f" children=0
    └── Text scope=5:18..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="]]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An HTML block owns its lines; a fenced code block owns its lines:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
<div>
%%
x
%%
</div>

```
%%
```
.
Document scope=1:1..9:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── HTMLBlock scope=1:1..5:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<div>\n%%\nx\n%%\n</div>\n" children=0
└── CodeBlock scope=7:1..9:3 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="%%\n" fenced=true closed=true children=0
````````````````````````````````

## An HTML comment beside a `%%` comment

Both grammars produce the same kind and neither sees inside the other; on a
line of its own, each grammar's block form is a block `Comment`:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
a <!-- b --> %%c%% <!--> %%%%

x <!-- %%d%% --> %%<!-- e -->%%
.
Document scope=1:1..3:31 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} children=8
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
│   ├── Comment scope=1:3..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b " children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:13..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Comment scope=1:14..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:19..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Comment scope=1:20..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:25..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Comment scope=1:26..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:31 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
    ├── Text scope=3:1..3:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=3:3..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" %%d%% " children=0
    ├── Text scope=3:17..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Comment scope=3:18..3:31 anchor=null attributes={} literal="<!-- e -->" children=0
````````````````````````````````
```````````````````````````````` example comment
<!-- a -->
%%
b
%%
.
Document scope=1:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Comment scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" a " children=0
└── Comment scope=2:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Marks and cross links beside comments

A comment inside a mark is content, the `==` inside a comment is the
comment's, and a comment may hold a whole mark or cross link:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
==a %%==b%% c== %%==d==%%
.
Document scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Mark scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │   ├── Text scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
    │   ├── Comment scope=1:5..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="==b" children=0
    │   └── Text scope=1:12..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" c" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:16..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Comment scope=1:17..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="==d==" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Inline containers, scopes, and lines

A body may span the lines of one paragraph inside any container; a comment
inside a heading, a link, or emphasis is content there:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
> a %%x
> y%% b

- a %%x
  y%% b

# a %%b%% c

[a %%b%%](/u) *%%c%%*
.
Document scope=1:1..9:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
├── Callout scope=1:1..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│       ├── Text scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
│       ├── Comment scope=1:5..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x\ny" children=0
│       └── Text scope=2:6..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b" children=0
├── List scope=4:1..6:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=4:1..6:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=4:3..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│           ├── Text scope=4:3..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
│           ├── Comment scope=4:5..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x\ny" children=0
│           └── Text scope=5:6..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b" children=0
├── Heading scope=7:1..7:11 anchor=null attributes={} level=1 children=3
│   ├── Text scope=7:3..7:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
│   ├── Comment scope=7:5..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
│   └── Text scope=7:10..7:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" c" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Link scope=9:1..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("/u") title=null children=2
    │   ├── Text scope=9:2..9:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
    │   └── Comment scope=9:4..9:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=9:14..9:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Emphasis scope=9:15..9:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Comment scope=9:16..9:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A comment that opened first owns a bracket or a delimiter inside it:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
[a %%](/u)%% b *c %%d* e%% f
.
Document scope=1:1..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[a " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:4..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="](/u)" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:13..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b *c " children=0
    ├── Comment scope=1:19..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d* e" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:27..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" f" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A `\|` inside a comment in a table cell becomes `|` in the literal, and an
empty comment in a cell is a comment:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
| a | b |
| - | - |
| %%c\|d%% | %%%% |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..3:19 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:6..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Comment scope=3:3..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c|d" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:13..3:18 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Comment scope=3:14..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

Footnote content holds inline and block comments like any other content:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
x[^n]

[^n]: a %%b%%

[^m]: %%
    c
    %%
.
Document scope=1:1..7:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:2..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:3..1:4 referent=footnote(id="n") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=3:1..4:0 id="n" children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│       ├── Text scope=3:7..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a " children=0
│       └── Comment scope=3:9..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
└── Footnote scope=5:1..7:6 id="m" children=1
    └── Comment scope=5:7..7:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Block form boundaries

Trailing spaces and tabs after either fence are allowed and belong to the
block's scope; indentation of one to three columns is allowed on both fences,
and the body keeps its own indentation:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%  
a
%%→ 

 %%
  a
   %%
.
Document scope=1:1..7:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Comment scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a\n" children=0
└── Comment scope=5:2..7:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="  a\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Four columns of indentation make an indented code block of the opener, and a
line indented four columns is body, not a closer:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
    %%
    a
    %%

%%
a
    %%
%%
.
Document scope=1:1..8:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── CodeBlock scope=1:5..4:0 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="%%\na\n%%\n" fenced=false closed=true children=0
└── Comment scope=5:1..8:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a\n    %%\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

An empty body, blank lines, and fence-looking lines that are not fences:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%
%%

%%

  a

%%

%%
%%%
%% a
a %%
%%
.
Document scope=1:1..14:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Comment scope=1:1..2:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="" children=0
├── Comment scope=4:1..8:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="\n  a\n\n" children=0
└── Comment scope=10:1..14:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%%\n%% a\na %%\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Consecutive block comments, and text on the line after a closer:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%
a
%%
%%
b
%%
c
.
Document scope=1:1..7:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Comment scope=1:1..3:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a\n" children=0
├── Comment scope=4:1..6:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b\n" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:1 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=7:1..7:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The candidate carries every open container's prefix: inside a list item
inside a block quote, with a blank line, and interrupting a paragraph inside a
list item and inside a block quote:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
> - %%
>   a
>
>   %%
> - b

- a
  %%
  b
  %%
  c

> a
> %%
> b
> %%
.
Document scope=1:1..16:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Callout scope=1:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── List scope=1:3..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
│       ├── ListItem scope=1:3..4:6 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│       │   └── Comment scope=1:5..4:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a\n\n" children=0
│       └── ListItem scope=5:3..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│           └── Paragraph scope=5:5..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│               └── Text scope=5:5..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
├── List scope=7:1..12:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=7:1..12:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=3
│       ├── Paragraph scope=7:3..7:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       │   └── Text scope=7:3..7:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│       ├── Comment scope=8:3..10:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b\n" children=0
│       └── Paragraph scope=11:3..11:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=11:3..11:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
└── Callout scope=13:1..16:4 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=2
    ├── Paragraph scope=13:3..13:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=13:3..13:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    └── Comment scope=14:3..16:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A candidate fails when its container ends before a closer, when the input
ends, or when the closer's indentation is not the candidate's: the opener line
is then paragraph text under the inline rule:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
> %%
> a

b
%%

- %%
  a
.
Document scope=1:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Callout scope=1:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│       ├── Text scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
│       ├── SoftBreak scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│       └── Text scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=4:1..5:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=4:1..4:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=4:2..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=5:1..5:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
└── List scope=7:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=7:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=7:3..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
            ├── Text scope=7:3..7:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
            ├── SoftBreak scope=7:5..7:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
            └── Text scope=8:3..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A candidate line that could be a lazy continuation is a block start instead,
and it closes the container it does not belong to:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
> para
%%
c
%%

- para
%%
d
%%
.
Document scope=1:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:3..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="para" children=0
├── Comment scope=2:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c\n" children=0
├── List scope=6:1..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=6:1..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} marker=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=6:3..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=6:3..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="para" children=0
└── Comment scope=7:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Block structure is decided before inline structure. A candidate with a closer
wins over a Setext underline and a thematic break inside it; one without a
closer is the paragraph a Setext underline makes a heading of:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
%%
---
%%

%%
===
.
Document scope=1:1..6:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Comment scope=1:1..3:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="---\n" children=0
└── Heading scope=5:1..6:3 anchor=null attributes={} level=1 children=1
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Inside a container directive the candidate stops at the directive's own
closing line:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
:::note
%%
x
%%
:::

:::note
%%
:::
%%
:::
.
Document scope=1:1..11:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── DirectiveBlock scope=1:1..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} name="note" children=1
│   └── Comment scope=2:1..4:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x\n" children=0
├── DirectiveBlock scope=7:1..9:3 anchor=null attributes={} name="note" children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=8:1..8:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=8:1..8:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=10:1..11:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=10:1..10:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="%%" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=10:3..10:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=11:1..11:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal=":::" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A candidate after a table, and an opener line that carries content after the
fence, which is inline placement:

```````````````````````````````` example comment
| a |
| - |
%%
x
%%

%% a
b
%%
.
Document scope=1:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Table scope=1:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null] children=1
│   ├── TableHead children=1
│   │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│   ├── TableBody children=0
│   └── TableFoot children=0
├── Comment scope=3:1..5:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x\n" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=7:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Comment scope=7:1..9:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" a\nb\n" children=0
````````````````````````````````
